name: Chapel Ledger
tagline: The operating system for the modern congregation.
positioning: One ledger for members, giving, and scheduling — so small church staffs stop stitching together spreadsheets and start leading their people.

hero.h1: Run your whole church from one honest ledger.
hero.sub: Chapel Ledger unifies membership, tithing, and volunteer scheduling into a single record of truth — built for the pastor who is also the bookkeeper, the sexton, and the IT department.

features.title: The Single Roll
features.description: Every member, family, and household in one canonical roll. No duplicate Marys, no orphaned emails, no more reconciling three directories before every mailing.

features.title: Giving, Reconciled
features.description: Track tithes, pledges, and one-time gifts, then export year-end statements in a single click. IRS-ready, plate-count to bank deposit, fully traceable.

features.title: The Rota, Solved
features.description: Schedule ushers, greeters, nursery, and worship teams with conflict detection. Volunteers confirm by text; empty slots surface before Sunday, not during it.

features.title: Pastoral Care Threads
features.description: Log visits, prayer requests, and follow-ups against the member record. Nothing important slips through when the whole team can see the thread.

features.title: One Roof, Many Hands
features.description: Give the treasurer, the secretary, and the deacons exactly the access they need — per seat, with a clean audit trail of who changed what.

features.title: Sunday, Automated
features.description: Attendance kiosks, offering counts, and follow-up sequences run themselves. Your staff walks in Monday to a service already summarized.

testimonials.quote: We were running the church on four spreadsheets and a shoebox of envelopes. Chapel Ledger gave us one roll and one number I actually trust at the annual meeting.
testimonials.name: Pastor Daniel Ruiz

testimonials.quote: Year-end giving statements used to eat my entire January. Now it's an afternoon. The audit trail alone settled two years of arguments with our finance committee.
testimonials.name: Marlene Osei

testimonials.quote: Our volunteer no-shows dropped by half once the rota started texting confirmations. I can finally see the empty nursery slot on Thursday instead of Sunday.
testimonials.name: Rev. Thomas Braddock

pricing.blurb: For the one-person office running a small congregation.
For growing churches with a real staff and real Sundays.
For multi-site ministries and denominational networks.

homepage.footerBlurb: Chapel Ledger is the record of truth for the modern congregation. One ledger. One roll. One Sunday at a time.
